snapshot.note: Evidence is graded at this timestamp. Concurrent cublasLt-exact and later FA4 work is not declared closed by this file.

grading.A: Candidate has whole-graph B29/S2 NSYS attribution, targeted NCU resource evidence, and correctness evidence.
grading.B: Candidate has isolated S1/S2 correctness plus targeted or partial NCU; it may also have fair boundary NSYS, but lacks whole-graph NSYS.
grading.C: Candidate has runtime correctness/timing evidence but no targeted NCU. This grade may include an unprofiled short whole-graph result.
grading.D: Static/source/environment analysis only; no candidate GPU result.
grading.rule: A route receives the grade of its strongest terminal candidate. Subvariants with weaker evidence are listed explicitly.

recommended_supplemental_experiments.why: It is the only closed/deferred boundary with an isolated S2 win and no terminal NCU/full-graph evidence. It is shorter than the failed QKV+RoPE fusion and retains the accepted RoPE kernel.
minimum_experiment: Create a formal bitwise validation record for the existing artifact.
Run targeted NCU for grid/cluster/shared-memory/register/wave identity.
If NCU does not show a gross long-exclusive shape, integrate only QKV and run one short current-baseline B29/S2 NSYS A/B.
Measure QKV exclusive/overlap, FA4 and FFN displacement, and total union; stop without long testing unless union improves.
recommended_supplemental_experiments.evidence_budget_reason: Existing artifact and isolated timings make this cheaper and better grounded than MSLK grouped-QKV or aux-stream implementation.

recommended_supplemental_experiments.caution: The maximum plausible gain is small because only 3.43% of current union is exposed by this boundary and 79.99% is already covered.

audit_conclusion: Most routes are genuinely closed at their claimed level. The important distinction is that FFN AB3 and fused QKV+RoPE already received the full resource-reversal test and failed, whereas plain planar QKV never did. Outproj+RMS M64 is the only isolated near-loss with a defensible but low-ceiling whole-graph reversal gap. These two experiments exhaust the supplemental budget; all other missing profiles are either dominated, grossly slower, numerically invalid, static-only, or obsolete against the retained FA4 baseline.
